headline: As of 2026-10-27: 34,635,096 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+11.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 34,635,096 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,116,398), California (3,382,645), Florida (3,280,369).
